inheritedFindings.claim: On the global Chat path a durably saved Message whose dispatch is deferred by the new `!runtime.isLoaded` barrier is abandoned without any notice if the user leaves the conversation instead of pressing retry, because the panel's claim is released on cleanup (`claimed && !retainClaim`), the resumed microtask returns on `cancelled`, and a conversation switch clears `promptPayload` — the Chat path has no equivalent of the model-only path's `chat.savedQuestionNotSent` disposition.
inheritedFindings.reproduction: In tests/e2e/chat-unified-workspace.spec.ts, take the new test "a committed Chat Message survives a history refresh started during its POST" and, after `state.releaseHistoryPageFailure()` and `await expect(page.getByTestId("chat-history-load-error")).toBeVisible()`, replace the `chat-history-load-retry` click with: click the sidebar item for SECOND_CONVERSATION, then click back to CONVERSATION. Observed: the saved user row "Finish the accepted request after the remount." is returned by the history GET with no assistant answer, `await persistentChatPostCount(page)` stays 0, and no toast is dispatched; expected (per criterion 5's honesty contract for a saved-but-undispatched Message) either the continued dispatch or a reload-to-check notice.

inheritedFindings.claim: The round-1 identity leak is fixed (the record is deleted on identity release, so the generation lookup fails and the toast is suppressed), but the gate is record-lifetime only, so a model-only turn that loses to a newer local run can still raise `savedQuestionNotSent` while the user is looking at a different conversation of the same account.
inheritedFindings.reproduction: Extend the new test "a Review question saved behind a newer turn is not mislabeled as unsaved": after `await expect.poll(state.messageSaveStarted).toBe(true)` and the newer global submit, click the sidebar item for SECOND_CONVERSATION before `state.releaseMessageSave()`; the toast "Your question was saved, but no answer request was sent…" appears on SECOND_CONVERSATION's screen, which names no conversation. Note this matches the project's existing convention — the adjacent `sendPreparationChanged` toast at ChatPageClient.tsx:4752 is likewise gated on identity, not conversation — so it is recorded rather than pressed.

inheritedFindings.claim: The Loading-state golden requirement of criterion 6 is now recorded as an actual Linux comparison (9/9, no snapshot update) and the workflow's overall `failure` is disclosed rather than dressed up as green, but the accompanying claim that the other 54 chat-state-visual-regression failures pre-date this change is supported only by reasoning about intervening main commits, not by a run of the same workflow at the base commit; I could not verify run 35700992823 at all with the read-only tool set this review is limited to.
inheritedFindings.reproduction: Run the same manually dispatchable `Nightly Visual Regression` workflow at base `ad2b51622992c29056706c443d80bdba928336e1` with `--retries=0` and no snapshot update, and compare its failing test set against run 35700992823's 54 failures; the diff under review does not touch chat-state-visual-regression.spec.ts, its snapshots, or the non-failed loading placeholder markup (ChatApp.tsx:2564-2570 keeps `data-testid="chat-panel-loading"` and the original class string), so the two sets are expected to match.
